formal_documents.sql: SELECT kind,id,version,updated_ms,data FROM documents WHERE kind IN ('definition','compiled_plan','entity','parameter','source','engine_state','recompute_outputs','recompute_run','recompute_state','recompute_state_info','revision') ORDER BY kind,id

observations.sql: SELECT * FROM observations ORDER BY id,observed_ms

latest.sql: SELECT * FROM latest ORDER BY device_id,key

rollups.sql: SELECT * FROM rollups ORDER BY device_id,key,granularity,bucket_ms

action_journal.sql: SELECT * FROM action_journal ORDER BY command_id
